## Goals
I am an epidemiologist and researcher working on infectious disease dynamics, mathematical modelling, and public health readiness.My work focuses on addressing critical public health challenges through epidemiological data analysis, mathematical modeling, and user-friendly surveillance tools.

## Education
- **MSc in Epidemiology** — London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine (2024–2026)
- **B.Eng.** — University of Transport and Communications, Hanoi (2011–2016)

## Experience
- **Research Assistant & Project Manager** — OUCRU Vietnam (2023–Present)  
  *Early warning systems, dengue surveillance pipelines (DART), and participatory outbreak modelling.*
- **Research Assistant (Biostatistics)** — OUCRU Vietnam (2022)  
  *COVID-19 transmission dynamics and interactive R Shiny dashboards.*
- **Research Assistant (Modelling)** — OUCRU Vietnam (2021)  
  *Epidemiological data pipelines and statistical modeling.*
